subject: general
question: The golden revolution in India related to the agriculture sector is referred to as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**horticulture and honey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The golden revolution in India is associated with **horticulture and honey**.
 
• This revolution emphasizes the significant growth and development in the production of fruits, vegetables, spices, flowers, and honey.
 
• It was aimed at diversifying agricultural activities and increasing income for farmers by promoting the cultivation of high-value horticultural crops.
 
• The efforts under this revolution have led to enhanced agricultural productivity and sustainability.
 
• Horticulture and honey production have played a crucial role in improving the nutritional intake and economic status of the rural population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term "Golden Revolution" was coined to reflect the substantial increase in the production of horticultural crops and honey.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of fruits and vegetables in the world, contributing significantly to global production.
 
• The government has implemented various schemes and initiatives to support horticulture, such as the National Horticulture Mission (NHM) and the Horticulture Mission for North East & Himalayan States (HMNEH).
 
• These initiatives aim to provide technical and financial support to farmers, improve infrastructure, and promote research and development in the horticulture sector.
